title: Duke Duck Adventure
description: Waddle, jump, and dash across charming retro side-scrolling stages as Duke the fearless duck—stomp quirky foes, dodge spikes, and claim sparkling treasure.
controls: Use left/right movement and jump buttons (or arrow keys / spacebar) to navigate platforms and defeat enemies.

zh-CN.title: 鸭子杜克大冒险
zh-CN.description: 复古横版动作闯关鸭子杜克大冒险：操控勇敢的杜克小鸭跳跃踩怪、跨越险峻平台与尖刺机关，通关寻宝乐趣无穷！
zh-CN.controls: 使用屏幕方向键与跳跃键（或键盘方向键/空格）控制鸭子杜克跑跳踩怪通关。
